error.magnitude: bounded below by SSS_017's residual: any formula construct still unread lowers the numerator, so 0.226 is a floor and not a two-sided estimate

coupling.basis: the domain of validity pins the instrument revision, so the claim does not move when that revision does. Coupling zero by construction, not by measurement.
